title: Positive-Characteristic Dichotomy and Optimal Three-Register Exponents in Passive Catalytic Register Programs
description: Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 formalization (verified across six independent kernel runs), exact-arithmetic and CaDiCaL 2.1.2 verification suite, deterministic vector figures, and AMS-LaTeX preprint answering open questions in passive catalytic register programs (Vinciguerra, arXiv:2609.18692; Morse, arXiv:2608.30238).
